criteria.criterion: every archetype passes the structural gate and independent review with no open blocker/major finding and a second verification
every ledger series has exactly one final assignment (reconciles exactly)
every in-scope series is assigned to an archetype that exists in the catalog
every review-added input is audited (definition, provenance, market-free class)
no catalog blocker remains open (a blocker closes only with a verified change to existing catalog ids)

catalog_blockers.action: Author a shared-weather common-shock interaction in the combos_and_parlays record: attach nfl.weather_pit and nfl.weather_total_response as conditioning variables of the joint leg draw, naming which leg pairs (total, kicker, QB/receiver yards) it couples.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The combos record lists common shocks for availability (nfl.common_availability_shock) and regime but no weather input at all, although wind moves total, kicker and passing legs together; the shared-weather interaction is missing from the record, not just unmeasured.

catalog_blockers.action: Author a cross-archetype output contract in the catalog: per-leg P(yes) plus a shared latent-state sample (margin, total, availability) exported by game_moneyline_spread, game_total, qb_passing_yards and anytime_first_td_scorer, and reference it from the combos_and_parlays inputs.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The combo layer needs per-leg marginals and a shared latent game-state sample from sibling archetypes, but no common output interface (fields, as-of time, shared draw of margin/total/availability) is defined anywhere in the catalog; this is a missing definition that authoring closes.

catalog_blockers.action: Rewrite the game_events OT stage and nfl.ot_model measurement: fix the rule set to the 2025+ both-possess 10-minute format and replace the 0/3/6 OT margin lattice with the full lattice (1,2,3,6,7,8 incl. 2-pt tries) used for P(level | OT) and tie hazard.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified: owners approved in April 2025 (effective 2025) a regular-season OT in which both teams get a possession even after an opening-drive TD, 10-minute period, ties still possible; nfl.ot_model already lists this variant. But the record's OT margin lattice of 0/3/6 is demonstrably wrong under both-possess (1, 2, 7, 8 occur), so the tie/level mechanism is wrong.

catalog_blockers.action: In the off_field_events record, author per-series reference classes (celebrity tryout-to-signing, minority stake sale completion, stadium construction milestone) under nfl.offfield_base_rate, or mark those series explicitly excluded with reason.
catalog_blockers.rationale: nfl.offfield_base_rate defines reference classes only for coach firings, trades and announcements; celebrity signings, ownership stake sales and stadium completion series have neither a reference class nor an explicit exclusion, so the record cannot state what prices them.

catalog_blockers.action: Revise nfl.vote_outcome_model and nfl.teammate_vote_split_penalty in season_awards: model ranked-ballot points (10-5-3-2-1 for MVP from 2022) with placement shares, split pre/post-2022 regimes, and record the ballot format for each other AP award.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified: since 2022 AP MVP uses 50 voters ranking five (10-5-3-2-1 points); 2025 MVP Stafford 366 vs Maye 361. nfl.teammate_vote_split_penalty is premised on plurality and fitted to first-place vote shares 2005-2025, which is wrong for ranked-points seasons and changes how second-place support enters.

catalog_blockers.action: Integrate-pass edit: rewrite nfl.team_score_pmf_own_mean and nfl.paired_score_covariance_own for single-team KXNFLTEAMTOTAL use, and move the both-teams-35 joint-tail definition to the game_total record that owns KXNFLBOTH.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The merged definitions of nfl.team_score_pmf_own_mean (measurement mentions KXNFLBOTH OT) and nfl.paired_score_covariance_own (mechanism/output describe the both-teams-35 tail) still describe a series re-filed to game_total, so the catalog text for team_total is demonstrably wrong.

catalog_blockers.action: Extend the unreg:combine_testing_results record with KXNFLCOMBINE-VERT and -BENCH: participant-pool inputs (bench: OL/DL-heavy, opt-out rates) and historical-max priors per drill, plus their rules text.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified on the Kalshi API: KXNFLCOMBINE 2026 has four events (Highest Vertical Jump, Longest Broad Jump, Most Bench Press Reps, Fastest 40); the record covers only broad jump and 40, so vertical and bench (lineman/DL pool) have no pools or priors.

catalog_blockers.action: Author a kicker (and D/ST) fantasy stage in unreg:fantasy_points_markets: FG attempts by distance from drive-stall lattice, nfl.kicker make rates, XP from team TD mean, and ESPN kicker/DST scoring weights.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The series includes a kicker over-9.2 fantasy market, but the chain has no kicker/defence stage: FG/XP opportunity from drive stalls and distance-tiered kicker scoring are not composed anywhere, although nfl.kicker and drive inputs exist to build it.

catalog_blockers.action: Author a player single-game specials archetype (or extend unreg:slate_extremes) with per-stat season-max-of-games inputs for receptions, receiving yards, tackles, sacks, non-passing TDs and defensive INTs, re-mapping each KXNFLGAMESPECIALS strike.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified on the Kalshi API: KXNFLGAMESPECIALS 2026-27 lists rushing 225-300, 100rush+100rec, receptions 15/17/20, receiving yards 275/300, tackles 20+, sacks 4-6, non-passing TDs 4+, and defensive INTs 2/3; the record has rushing inputs only.

catalog_blockers.action: Split unreg:team_and_event_counting_specials into per-family archetypes (team counts, score-path functionals, rare play calls, league tie/long-kick counts) and remap each series, reusing rushing and bracket chains.
catalog_blockers.rationale: This unregistered archetype still mixes per-team counts, both-team counts, score-path functionals, rare play calls and league tie/long-kick counts that need distinct chains; that is a series-to-archetype mapping defect.

catalog_blockers.action: Amend cfb.bowl_selection_state: count at most one qualifying FCS win, add an opponent-division flag per game and an NCAA APR score source for the 5-7 fallback order, citing the current NCAA postseason bylaw and any 2026 waiver.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Checked: only one win over an FCS opponent (meeting the scholarship requirement) counts toward six, and 5-7 teams fill unfilled slots in APR order. cfb.bowl_selection_state counts raw wins >=6 and has no FCS-opponent win cap or APR source, so the definition is demonstrably wrong and needs new raw inputs (opponent division per win, APR scores).

catalog_blockers.action: Make cfb.cfp_ranking_resume_features the canonical committee rank input (or the reverse), merge feature lists, and alias the other id in the season_futures and unreg:polls_and_cfp_rankings records.
catalog_blockers.rationale: cfb.cfp_committee_resume_model (season_futures) and cfb.cfp_ranking_resume_features (polls_and_cfp_rankings) define the same committee rank model with different feature lists; two diverging definitions of one input is a catalog defect fixed by authoring, not data.

catalog_blockers.action: Re-check live Kalshi CFB TD series, re-key touchdown_scorer to the live team/game TD-count series (td_count_dispersion, td_per_scoring_trip, dst_td_propensity primary) and mark the player part dormant with player inputs secondary.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The archetype is keyed to anytime/first player TD markets, but the ledger's live series are team and game TD counts; player-role inputs (td_rates, depth_chart, player_usage) are primary for absent series. That is a series/archetype mapping defect in the records.

catalog_blockers.action: Alias cfb.opp_dropback_volume to cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts (opponent view) in the team_event_counting_specials and season_stat_leader records, or document a distinct defensive-view definition.
catalog_blockers.rationale: cfb.opp_dropback_volume's own definition says it measures the same quantity as cfb.script_adjusted_pass_attempts plus cfb.state_dependent_pace and should be aliased; two definitions of one input across split archetypes is an unresolved catalog duplication.

catalog_blockers.action: Add an appeal stage (filing and grant probability) to nba.games_played_eligibility / nba.eligibility_minutes_ledger in awards_draft, and record the verified list of governed awards (MVP, DPOY, MIP, All-NBA, All-Defense) with exemptions.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified via 2026 reporting: eligibility = 65 games (20+ min in 63, 15-20 min allowed in two more), covering MVP, DPOY, MIP, All-NBA and All-Defense; ROY, Sixth Man and All-Rookie exempt (secondary source). Also verified: an 'extraordinary circumstances' appeal to an NBA/NBPA-designated expert can grant eligibility (Doncic and Cunningham granted, Edwards denied, 2025-26). The record has no appeal stage, so eligibility is not a pure ledger gate.

catalog_blockers.action: In awards_draft, rewrite nba.allstar_reserve_coach_vote to positionless selection and add a nationality-quota/Commissioner-addition stage with a player nationality input. Mark the 2027 format as pending until the league announces it.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified for 2026: starters 50% fans / 25% players / 25% media; coaches pick 7 reserves per conference regardless of position (positionless); the USA-vs-World format needs 16 US and 8 international All-Stars, with the Commissioner adding players to fill the quotas. The record's position-group split is wrong, and the nationality quota plus Commissioner additions are a selection stage it lacks.

catalog_blockers.action: Author an nba.hustle_stat_index input (league hustle-stats endpoint, award formula weights) and attach it to KXNBAHUSTLE in awards_draft. Keep Teammate and Sportsmanship on the generic nominee model.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The Hustle Award is chosen by formula from tracked hustle stats (deflections, charges drawn, loose balls, screen assists, contests). No catalog input aggregates those stats, so the KXNBAHUSTLE mechanism has no driver. This is a missing input, not a magnitude.

catalog_blockers.action: Author a joint governance scenario input (expansion award -> realignment -> European announcement, keyed to board calendars) in off_court_events. Wire the three series to it in place of independent hazards.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Expansion awards, conference realignment (two new Western cities force teams East) and a European-league announcement are causally linked board decisions. The record prices KXNBACITYEXPAND, KXNBAJOINCONF and KXNBAEUROPEANNOUNCE as independent events. A joint dependence structure is missing, not just unmeasured.

catalog_blockers.action: Link the NHL catalog's Stanley Cup title input by id with as-of timestamp alignment (or define a shared cross-sport input) and attach it to KXNBANHL in parlay_combo.
catalog_blockers.rationale: KXNBANHL needs a Stanley Cup probability, and no NBA input defines or references one. The cross-sport link (input id, as-of alignment) is missing from the record.

catalog_blockers.action: Relabel player_availability as season-level availability/one-off status, move or drop the game-level 30-minute-confirmation stage, and update its series list after checking whether game-level markets list.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The archetype is labelled game-level starter/active status, but its live contracts are season-level one-offs, and the game-level mechanism has no live series. That is an archetype-to-series mapping defect in the records.

catalog_blockers.action: Move KXNBABENCHPTS out of player_points to team_total (or game_overtime_and_team_events, which owns nba.team_bench_points_model and nba.starter_bench_definition_ledger), and update both records' series lists.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Checked live: KXNBABENCHPTS uses Kalshi's BASKETBALLENTITYSTAT terms with scope 'Bench Points' (title 'NBA Bench Points'), a team-entity stat, not a player contract. Filing it under player_points is a series mapping defect.

catalog_blockers.action: In quarter_and_half_markets, define the OT-inclusive 2H margin as regulation 2H margin plus an OT increment from nba.ot_prob_ratings_margin, and map KXNBA2HWINNER and KXNBA2H to the two outputs.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The texts are explicit: KXNBA2H, 2HSPREAD and 2HTOTAL include OT, and 2HWINNER excludes it. No input defines how one simulated game yields both the regulation-only and the OT-inclusive 2H margin, so that definition is missing.

catalog_blockers.action: Author a live-state input set in quarter_and_half_markets (score at period start, clock, on-court lineups, team-foul/bonus state from cdn.nba.com liveData) and attach it to the Q2-Q4 and 2H series.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Checked live via the Kalshi API: KXNBA2H-26NOV07SASPOR markets have close_time 05:35Z, after the game ended, with early close 'after a winner is declared'. Later-period markets trade in play, so in-game state inputs are required and the record has none.

catalog_blockers.action: Mark nba.division_race_tiebreak_state DUPLICATE_OF nba.tiebreak_ledger in the NBA catalog, and code the 2026-27 league tiebreak procedure into nba.tiebreak_ledger for season_futures_team.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The tiebreak order is a published rule that does not change inputs. The record does carry two inputs for one mechanism, nba.division_race_tiebreak_state and nba.tiebreak_ledger, with no duplicate marking, which is a demonstrable catalog defect.

catalog_blockers.action: Define one shared regular-season path simulation input referenced by season_futures_team and season_stat_markets, and record nba.team_win_streak_hazard and nba.longest_streak_max_and_tie_model as views of it.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Streak contracts and win totals sit in two archetypes that need the same season path simulation. nba.team_win_streak_hazard and nba.longest_streak_max_and_tie_model overlap, and no shared simulation is defined.

catalog_blockers.action: Decide and record in series_and_cup whether Cup contracts move to their own archetype (with nba.cup_format, nba.cup_group_tiebreak_state) and file the comeback/blowout series with in-game score inputs.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Cup group/knockout contracts and the comeback/blowout series contracts sit in a best-of-seven archetype with different mechanisms and data. The records have not decided whether to split or keep a separate stage: an open archetype mapping defect.

catalog_blockers.action: In series_and_cup, update nba.cup_finals_pair_probability and nba.cup_format: home-court for the higher seed in the semifinal, no shared-venue copula, neutral final at Hinkle Fieldhouse, and wild card = best second-place team per conference.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified for 2026-27: three group winners plus one wild card per conference make conference-split quarterfinals. Semifinals are now at the higher seed's arena and only the final is neutral, at Hinkle Fieldhouse, Indianapolis. The record wrongly gives the semifinal zero home advantage and models a shared semifinal site.

catalog_blockers.action: Author one shared nba.playoff_bracket_simulation input (play-in to Finals, series lengths, advancement) and make season_futures_team, player_milestones, series_and_cup and the playoff-points record reference it.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Series lengths and advancement are consumed by season_futures_team, player_milestones and the playoff-points record, but no single shared bracket simulation input is defined. Each consumer references pieces, which leaves the catalog structurally incomplete.

catalog_blockers.action: Add a legend-participant skill component and the format fields (teams, composition, spots/values, rounds, tie replay) to nba.shooting_stars_team_skill in all_star_weekend_events, read from the league's format release.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Partly verified: the 2026 Shooting Stars had four teams of two current stars plus one legend, with a tied final round replayed. Point values and time limits were not found. A retired 'legend' participant needs a skill input that nba.shooting_stars_team_skill lacks, which changes the input list.

catalog_blockers.action: Split all_star_weekend_events into skills contests, team exhibitions and MVP archetypes (or author an exhibition blueprint) and reassign each series' inputs.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Seven disjoint processes share one record with per-series input scoping, and no blueprint fits. Whether to split into contests, exhibitions and MVP archetypes is an unresolved archetype mapping defect.

catalog_blockers.action: Read the 2026 ASG MVP voting description and record panel size, fan-vote weight and scope in nba.asg_mvp_vote_model. Add a fan-vote input if confirmed.
catalog_blockers.rationale: 2026 MVP (Kobe Bryant Trophy) went to Anthony Edwards. Sources indicate a fan-vote component via NBA ID, but the media panel and scope (decisive game vs whole round robin) are unverified. A fan-vote share changes nba.asg_mvp_vote_model's inputs.

catalog_blockers.action: Relabel the archetype as playoff single-game player thresholds (or merge with KXNBAPLAYOFF3D in player_milestones) and replace its catalog input list with the staged inputs.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The archetype is labelled counting specials but its only live series is playoff single-game points, and its catalog input list is stale. That is an archetype/series mapping defect.

catalog_blockers.action: Rewrite cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model measurement with the 2027 NIT rules (24 teams, top-10 KenPom-conference exempt bids, champion auto bids at avg rank <=125), add conference KenPom ranking and multi-metric average rank as required raw inputs, and research/record the 2027 College Basketball Crown conference allocation for futures_champion.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified (NCAA, 1 Oct 2026): the 2027 NIT shrinks to 24 teams; exempt bids go one each to the highest-ranked eligible team of the top-10 KenPom conferences, auto bids to non-NCAA regular-season champions with average metric rank <=125. cbb.secondary_postseason_field_model defines eligibility from NET rank only, so its rule table and required rank inputs are now wrong; 2027 Crown allocation is still unresearched.

catalog_blockers.action: Attach cbb.tournament_field_format to the futures_seed_other record, record the verified 76-team structure (44 at-large, 12 Opening Round games, round labels) in its measurement, and update cbb.auto_bid_structure/committee seed-model text that assumes 36 at-large and a 68-team First Four.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified: 2027 field is 76 teams (44 at-large, 12 Opening Round games of the 12 lowest at-large and 12 lowest auto-bid teams, First Four name dropped). futures_seed_other prices at-large/bubble and round-qualification series (KXMARMADROUND 'Round of 76') but does not attach cbb.tournament_field_format, so its input list is missing the format definition.

catalog_blockers.action: Attach cbb.venue_scorekeeper_stat_bias to the player_rebounds_assists record inputs (secondary role, assists/rebounds) and add the venue-bias interaction to its mechanism text; magnitude testing stays with pr_scorekeeper_effect.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The catalog already defines cbb.venue_scorekeeper_stat_bias for assists/blocks/rebounds and wires it to player_props, but the player_rebounds_assists record, whose assist props it targets, does not attach it; the record itself says no attached input captures venue assist bias. That is a wiring defect; the magnitude is then empirical.

catalog_blockers.action: Author a new input (e.g. cbb.concurrent_vacancy_competition: open vacancies in the same cycle, their resources/attractiveness rank and candidate overlap) and attach it to unreg:coaching_and_governance_events, with an interaction against cbb.program_hiring_resources.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Competing simultaneous vacancies are a real mechanism stage (rival openings remove candidates); the record's own mechanism review says no input tracks the carousel, and none of the 16 attached inputs (search state, program resources, availability calendar) models rival openings.

catalog_blockers.action: Author a Jack Adams stage in season_awards_and_stats: a coach-level conditional logit over ~30 coaches on nhl.coach_expectation_delta (with tenure flags) using the NHLBA electorate, as a coach branch of nhl.award_vote_share_model.
catalog_blockers.rationale: nhl.coach_expectation_delta is defined but no stage maps it to a winner probability among ~30 coaches: nhl.award_vote_share_model is specified for player awards with writer/GM electorates, so the Jack Adams path lacks a mechanism stage.

catalog_blockers.action: Add a post-deadline tanking stage to season_futures s5 for KXNHLRECORDWORST: wire nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing and nhl.standings_stakes (elimination status) as inputs adjusting bottom-team points rates.
catalog_blockers.rationale: KXNHLRECORDWORST (s5 argmin) has no input for draft-lottery tanking: nhl.draft_lottery_odds_by_standing and nhl.standings_stakes exist in the catalog but are not wired into season_futures, so the bottom-of-table effort mechanism is missing from the record.

catalog_blockers.action: Extend nhl.goalie_start_forecast with a playoff branch (starter-change hazard given previous-game save% and series state) and add it to s1 input_ids of unreg:playoff_series_aggregate and season_futures s4.
catalog_blockers.rationale: nhl.goalie_start_forecast is defined around regular-season rotation (back-to-backs, 3-in-4); no input defines the playoff starter-change hazard after a poor game, which drives per-game goalie identity in s1 of this record.

catalog_blockers.action: Edit first_inning_and_inning_markets: strip F3/F5-specific content from mlb.f3_split, mlb.tto and the PA dataset, keep only inputs serving RFI/INNINGTOTAL/INNINGWIN, and list live inning strikes from the series ledger.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Records defect: mlb.f3_split, mlb.tto and the PA dataset still carry F3/F5 content from a superseded filing, so the input list of the archetype is wrong for KXMLBRFI, KXMLBINNINGTOTAL and KXMLBINNINGWIN.

catalog_blockers.action: Define one shared pa_base_out_state_chain input and attach it to hitter_hits_and_total_bases for KXMLBHRR's runs/RBI legs, mirroring hitter_rbis_runs_sb.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Missing interaction: KXMLBHRR's runs and RBI components lack the lineup-neighbour base-out chain (pa_base_out_state_chain) that the RBI archetype defines, so the hits record's input list is incomplete for HRR.

catalog_blockers.action: Attach the shared probable-pitcher-change input (from first5_markets) to hitter_home_runs and redefine pitcher_hr_vulnerability as a mixture over announced and replacement starters.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Missing input: the HR ladder evaluates pitcher_hr_vulnerability for the announced starter only and has no probable-pitcher-change input, although a scratch of the opposing starter does not trigger fair price.

catalog_blockers.action: Revise hitter_rbis_runs_sb scope to KXMLBRBI and KXMLBSB, drop runs-scored inputs unless the series ledger shows a runs ladder, and confirm KXMLBSB filing versus counting specials.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Series/archetype mapping defect: the record's scope claims runs scored though no runs-scored series is filed, and only KXMLBRBI and KXMLBSB belong to it, so scope and inputs disagree with the filed series.

catalog_blockers.action: Detach sale-stage hazard, manager award score, esports rating and manager candidate signal from offfield_markets and attach each to the archetype now holding its series.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Records defect: inputs for series that left offfield_markets (sale stage hazard, manager award score, esports rating, manager candidate signal) remain attached and would be integrated into the wrong archetype.

catalog_blockers.action: Author one shared starter exit-hazard input id and remap sp_workload, sp_hook_hazard_curve and exit_boundary_mass in pitcher_strikeouts, pitcher_outs and pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks to it.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Definition defect: the starter exit hazard is defined three times (sp_workload/leash, sp_hook_hazard_curve, exit_boundary_mass) across sibling archetypes, which would be fitted separately and drift apart.

catalog_blockers.action: Add a pitcher K% prior input to pitcher_strikeouts (pitch-model stuff grade or ZiPS/Steamer projection) with source and blending rule versus k_rates and pitch_type_whiff.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Missing input: pitcher talent has no stuff-model or projection K% prior, so arsenal changes, injury returns and rookies have no defined information source where whiff samples are thinnest.

catalog_blockers.action: Stage mlb.labor_stoppage_regime in player_participation for 2027 KXMLBSTART/STARTER/PITCH windows and record cancelled-game treatment as a contract dependency.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Missing attachment: 2027 KXMLBSTART/STARTER/PITCH windows depend on mlb.labor_stoppage_regime, defined in transactions but not staged here. CBA expiry verified as 11:59 pm ET Dec 1 2026.

catalog_blockers.action: Define an opposing-probable-starter input (identity, throwing hand, announcement timestamp) and attach it to the player_participation manager-decision stage.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Missing input: platoon start decisions depend on the opposing probable starter's identity, hand and announcement time, and no input in player_participation carries them; platoon is only a stand-in.

catalog_blockers.action: Author a postseason round and active-roster-eligibility input for player_participation and specify a separate postseason branch of the manager-decision stage.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Missing input: sampled start markets are postseason games where round-specific roster eligibility gates who can start, yet the manager-decision stage has only regular-season rest-day constructs.

catalog_blockers.action: Split season_leaders_and_awards award models by electorate: add fan-vote input for Hank Aaron, panel/beat-writer models for Reliever and Comeback, citing each body's procedure.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified electorates differ: Rivera/Hoffman by a six-reliever panel, Hank Aaron by Hall of Fame panel plus fan vote, Comeback by 30 MLB.com beat reporters. One shared Plackett-Luce model is wrong; inputs differ (fan-vote term).

catalog_blockers.action: Rewrite KXMLBEOTY inputs in season_leaders_and_awards: executive-voter model on front-office/team-improvement signals, removing public-ballot and manager inputs.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Verified: MLB Executive of the Year is voted by executives of all 30 clubs at the start of the postseason, with no public ballots, so the BBWAA-style rank model, public-ballot and manager win-over-expectation inputs do not apply.

catalog_blockers.action: Define narrative flags (milestone, comeback, first-year, position scarcity) with tagging rules and sources as a concrete input of the award vote-share models.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Missing definition: narrative is listed as an award-vote driver but has no operational measure or tagging rule, so the input cannot be computed at all; the effect-size part is secondary.

catalog_blockers.action: List every KXMLBSTAT ticker in the series ledger, keep velocity markets in pitch_velocity_extremes and route other stat markets to an archetype with suitable inputs.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Series mapping defect: KXMLBSTAT is a generic season-stat series and only one velocity market was sampled; non-velocity KXMLBSTAT markets would be mis-routed to the velocity archetype.

catalog_blockers.action: Split player_and_team_counting_specials into postseason-count, player-exposure and scoreless-streak archetypes, each with its own mechanism and input list.
catalog_blockers.rationale: Archetype mapping defect: five series with three mechanisms (postseason league counts, player HR exposure, scoreless streak) share one input list that serves none fully.

catalog_blockers.action: Attach soc.cross_tier_strength_link and soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch to the btts_and_clean_sheet record (inputs list and the stage that sets each side's lambda), stating they apply to cross-division cup ties (Copa del Rey, Israeli Cup, Copa do Brasil early rounds).
catalog_blockers.rationale: soc.cross_tier_strength_link and soc.favourite_rotation_in_mismatch now exist in the catalog inputs and are attached to handicap_and_exact_score, but neither appears in the btts_and_clean_sheet inputs or stages, so the weaker-side lambda in cross-tier cup ties has no defined source in this record; the min-lambda calibration itself is empirical.

catalog_blockers.action: Attach soc.transfers (manager-change flag, rating re-blend) and soc.manager_dismissal_hazard to the competition_head_to_head record and its table-order stage, so a future in-window change is simulated as hazard x strength shift; leave the shift magnitude to the event study.
catalog_blockers.rationale: The catalog defines the manager-change mechanism (soc.transfers: manager-change flag with matches since change and prior/in-season rating re-blend; soc.manager_dismissal_hazard for a pending sacking), but neither is attached to competition_head_to_head, whose finish-ahead contracts span the rest of the season; the effect size itself is empirical.

catalog_blockers.action: Attach soc.weather to first_half_and_period and author an interaction soc.weather x soc.period_split (temperature/humidity/altitude shifting the second-half share of lambda) in the half-split stage, with the regression on kickoff weather named as its test.

acceptance.note: Meeting the documented criteria is necessary, not sufficient, and is never approval. Reviewers and verifiers are Claude agents, not human domain experts.

approval.note: no human approval recorded; code never writes this

criteria: structure valid (13-category mechanism coverage, staged mechanism, >=4 interactions incl. form+test, >=2 nonlinearities, required-data definitions with sources and access)
every pre-existing archetype input individually audited (keep/weak/duplicate/irrelevant/benchmark-only with a reason)
contract text: verbatim quotes from sampled Kalshi rules for >=2 series where rules exist; ledger-checked tickers; edge cases listed
no boilerplate: stage and interaction text not near-duplicated across archetypes (5-gram Jaccard < 0.35)
at least one explicit unresolved gap per archetype (no archetype may be declared complete)
independent second review recorded with no open BLOCKER/MAJOR finding
second independent verification (different model) of every closed blocker/major finding: each CONFIRMED or CORRECTED, none REOPENED
records edited by the reconcile pass (series re-filed, rules text recovered) are re-audited by an independent verifier after the edit
READY_FOR_USER_APPROVAL is the ceiling: the human decision lives in approval.json and is never written by code
